N_next = R0 * N * exp(-alpha * N) * (N / (N + N_allee)) * (1 / (1 + (N / N_refuge)**q_pred)) * exp(-beta_temp * (T - T_opt)**2) * (1 / (1 + (R_precip / (P + P_half)))) * (1 / (1 + (N / N_refuge)**q_pred * exp(-gamma_wet * P / (P + P_wet_half))))
